openrouter.implementation: OAuth PKCE and owner/key-bound entitlement receipt; policy and exact-zero model discovery required
openrouter.blocker: User-delegated eligible Free account required; environment credential is not a user grant
openrouter.privacy: Consent and upstream policy dependent; private-code admission remains separately gated

cloudflare-workers-ai.implementation: Encrypted account credential path and neuron budget guard; entitlement admission remains unavailable
cloudflare-workers-ai.blocker: Available token lacks access to account/billing evidence. Subscriptions require Billing Read; account entitlements require Account Read. Missing or empty subscription data cannot prove Workers Free.
cloudflare-workers-ai.billing: Workers Free has a provider-enforced daily hard stop; Workers Paid and AI Gateway credits can incur charges. Local budget estimation alone cannot prove no paid spillover.
cloudflare-workers-ai.privacy: Private-code compatible only after actual admission verification

groq.implementation: Encrypted user credential connection and model discovery
groq.blocker: Public API catalog proves model access only. No supported authoritative owner/billing-tier endpoint found; rate-limit headers cannot prove Free billing tier.

cerebras.implementation: Encrypted user credential connection and model discovery
cerebras.blocker: Provider explicitly offers only time/credit-bounded Free Trial; no recurring permanent Free tier

puter.implementation: Browser user sign-in available; aggregate allowance is insufficient
puter.blocker: Documented MonthlyUsage allowanceInfo exposes monthUsageAllowance and remaining, without Free/purchased buckets or a Free-only spending selector; no inference performed. R65 re-probe (2026-10-02): puter.com markets a $10/month subscription, and the developer FAQ documents a 'User-Pays' model — authenticated users are billed against their own Puter account resources. Anonymous keyless puter.ai.chat calls are rate-limited/blocked by Puter's own security layer; there is no committed $0 route.

pollinations.implementation: Not implemented — legacy anonymous surface only
pollinations.blocker: Anonymous inference works on the legacy text.pollinations.ai surface (user_tier:"anonymous", real usage accounting), but it serves exactly one model and publishes no quota headers. The current authoritative docs (gen.pollinations.ai APIDOCS, Pollen billing) do not mention an anonymous tier at all — the free surface is a legacy compatibility path whose durability and terms cannot be pinned to any authoritative document. Fail-closed: unverifiable free status stays un-admitted.

ollama-cloud.implementation: User-connected Free starter allowlist, feature-flagged (ollamaUserConnectedFreeEnabled), attest-gated; live pricing page re-verified 2026-10-02
ollama-cloud.privacy: Provider states prompts/responses are not logged or trained on; managed-relay terms unreviewed
ollama-cloud.blocker: Signed-in session authenticates the account but exposes no documented programmatic plan/billing endpoint — ollama.com/settings/usage is a web surface, not API evidence. Free plan includes a starter usage amount scoped to a starter-model allowlist (resets monthly); purchased credits unlock all models and are consumed after included usage. Without a verifiable no-purchased-credits signal, the only honest boundary is user attestation + starter-model confinement — which is what the implemented path does. A signed-in session alone cannot prove the free-vs-paid boundary.
